item.title: 🔵 Entra PIM vs. Delinea vs. CyberArk: Don’t Buy the Wrong PAM
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
Entra PIM grants roles; Delinea and CyberArk vault credentials. Compare scope, session recording, audit evidence, and three-year cost.
